Elena P.: FYI we just ingested a delayed export from a hardware OEM (edgebox v2.0). ~12k lines showing negative deltas in customer ledgers. We need to formalize a partner backfill policy and required evidence for retro credits. cc @Raj S.

BillingBot: Ingest report: delivery_ts=2026-04-02T14:05:12Z, file=batch_20260402_edgebox_v2_0.ndjson, events=12087, checksum=f7a9...

Raj S.: Can you attach a small redacted sample of the events? important to see event_id, usage_ts, and any partner-side replay_id fields.

Elena P.: sample below (redacted):```json
{"partner":"edgebox","batch":"b-20260329-xx","events":[{"evt":"e-001","usage_ts":"2026-03-29T03:10:12Z","units":500},{"evt":"e-002","usage_ts":"2026-03-29T03:11:45Z","units":-200}]}
```

Omar T.: Negative units indicate either corrections or out-of-order replays. We cannot auto-apply corrections older than a short window without replay_id or signed justification. Proposal from infra: add a required `replay_id` and optional `correction_reason` enum to webhook contract; enforce idempotency at ingestion.

Raj S.: From Billing: suggest thresholds - auto-apply if arrival_delay <=48h. For delays 48h-10d partner must submit audit CSV with row-level hashes + signed manifest; we apply after a quick review. >10d require finance approval and manual ledger reconciliation. Need to consider invoice cutoffs to avoid chasing credits mid-period.

Elena P.: Agreed. Also recommend ledger tagging `partner_backfill` and adding a human-readable comment field so finance can trace credits back to partner artifacts.

Legal Bot: Note: anything that leads to customer-facing balance changes older than 30 days may require a contract amendment depending on partner terms. Loop in partner legal for >30d corrections.

Raj S.: Action items: 1) Update metering contract to require `replay_id`, `original_event_ts`, `manifest_checksum`. 2) Implement ingestion dedupe by `replay_id` and mark backfill_reason if present. 3) Add daily backfill audit report (per partner): counts, avg lag, flagged-negative-deltas. I'll open billing ticket and set tentative thresholds as above.

Elena P.: I'll prepare the partner communication with the new payload schema and evidence checklist (include sample audit CSV layout). We'll pilot with the OEM for two weeks.

Omar T.: For runtime: we'll add a boolean `is_backfill` flag on ledger entries and an index for `replay_id` to speed dedupe. Also add a safety cap: if net ledger delta for a single partner exceeds X% of monthly usage, escalate to ops.

Raj S.: :white_check_mark: Finance is okay with the flow pending implementation. Please include a sample reconciliation CSV in the announcement.

Elena P.: Thanks all. I'll post the draft partner bulletin in #partnerships-drafts for review before sending. If no pushback, we'll enable the new validation rules on 2026-04-15 and start the OEM pilot the following week.

BillingBot: Created ticket BILL-7721 - "partner-backfill-proofing-and-ingest-dedupe" assigned to Raj S., due 2026-04-12.
